requirements.title_vi: Sửa lỗi tài khoản bị khóa không lý do
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to access my account without it being locked unexpectedly, so that I can use the app without interruptions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has an active account, when they attempt to log in, then they should be able to access their account without being locked out.
Given a user has created a new account, when they try to make a purchase, then they should not encounter an error that locks their account.
Given a user is trying to link their bank account, when they perform the action, then they should not receive an error that prevents the linking process.

requirements.title_vi: Cải thiện trải nghiệm quảng cáo
requirements.user_story: As a shopper, I want to avoid being redirected to Shopee while using the app, so that I can enjoy a smoother shopping experience.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am using the app, when I interact with the interface, then I should not be redirected to Shopee unexpectedly.
Given I am browsing products, when I click on items, then I should remain in the app without being taken to Shopee.
Given I am playing a game or using another feature, when I receive notifications, then they should not disrupt my current activity by redirecting me to Shopee.

requirements.title_vi: Bổ sung tính năng chọn đơn vị giao hàng
requirements.user_story: As a shopper, I want to choose the delivery service, so that I can track my order more effectively.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the checkout page, when I select a delivery option, then I should see the available delivery services listed.
Given I have selected a delivery service, when I confirm my order, then the selected delivery service should be used for my order.
Given I have an order in progress, when I check the delivery status, then I should see the delivery service I selected.
